name: Koshu (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Koshu city emblem in white: four discs with lozenge-shaped notches arranged in a cross, like a flower.
history: Municipal flag of Koshu, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 2005.

features.role: Koshu city emblem — four discs with lozenge-shaped notches arranged in a cross, like a flower
